Unmodified Chromium Hunspell binary dictionaries for Electron 39.

en-US-10-1.bdic:
https://redirector.gvt1.com/edgedl/chrome/dict/en-us-10-1.bdic

de-DE-3-0.bdic:
https://redirector.gvt1.com/edgedl/chrome/dict/de-de-3-0.bdic

Source dictionaries, notices, and licenses:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/deps/hunspell_dictionaries/

The upstream LICENSE and language README files are included alongside the
unmodified dictionaries. These files are standalone data used by Chromium's
spellchecker, not fonts or user document content.
